lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Every island carried the Current. The water used to sing.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Wait. The aqueduct went quiet. No… not the Crown.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: I kept waiting for the lights to come back.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: You're still here! I'm Luma. Let's help each other.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: See that receiver? Let's wake the first connection.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: It worked!

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Look! The light is traveling again.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: It's heading to the reservoir. Come on!

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: I remember this place.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: The gardens used to get their water from here.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: There's a connection below us. Follow me.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: The mark from the lower channel. The terminal still works!

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Stability directive active. Flow halted to prevent instability.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: It wasn't an accident. Someone shut it down.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: That symbol… I've seen it before.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: I remember that sound.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Everything used to move together.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Something's missing. I can't remember what.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Whatever happened started at the Crown.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: That's the heart of Aero Haven.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: The intake sends water to the relay.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: The relay powers the Crown.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Wake the Crown and the islands get power.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Let's wake it together.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Intake. Relay. Crown!

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: We did it! The water's back!

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: I'm glad you found me.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Uncontrolled growth detected.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Eco Canopy. Something's wrong.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Look at this place. The forest isn't dead.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: It's trying to grow.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Something won't let it.
